content: The last four years have been intense. I've been at Deloitte for most of it and was freelancing at the beginning of 2018. 36 clients, a ton of learning, and a number of personal victories worth commemorating in a visual. In lieu of the usual personal retro my friend group and I do together, I took some time to combine the year end maps I make for performance panel reviews with the firm. Four of these suckers, plenty.
